# scripts/Combat/PlayerCombat.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Combat/PlayerCombat.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Player combat state machine: melee, defence, bow, kick, dodge, and drop attacks.
Runs as the player Combat child and uses the inventory selection as weapon.
Blows and projectiles use gameplay head aim, independent of camera effects.
See docs/systems/combat.md for controls, phases, attack schemas, and signals.

Base: `Node`. Registered class: `none`.

cut high through the neck takes the head, low the legs (a sweep both), and
between them the arm nearest it (at the elbow if the forearm was nearer).

any once he is weak enough. A point goes in and cuts nothing off; a
dagger is too short to take a limb.
